name: anything-obsidian
description: Local MCP tools for Anything Obsidian (per-vault RAG search, raw vault reads and vault management, loopback 21503) plus the vault-workflow skill. Requires a running any-obs install (anything-obsidian start). Codex agents joining a team server without an install: configure the server's :21500/mcp in ~/.codex/config.toml with bearer_token_env_var — see docs/agent-mcp.md.
